# Development tooling

Shared development instructions are kept here to leave the repository root focused on the application. These files remain public and versioned; this is organization, not a privacy boundary or a history rewrite.

For local automatic discovery, copy `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md` and `CLAUDE.md` from this directory to the repository root. Those local copies are ignored by Git; refresh them after changing the maintained instructions. Paths in instructions are relative to the repository root unless given as Markdown links. Existing `.agents/` skills and `.codex/` configuration are preserved.

Product documentation starts at [docs/README.md](../../docs/README.md).
